# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** Seven years old  <sub>[v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c10 P48](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0048)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v2 c30 P32](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0032)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Grafton  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Dora is a fair, pale child with a straight nose, a 'prunes and prisms' mouth, and a neat, prim appearance as if she has just been starched and ironed. She has long, sleek, fine, fawn-colored hair that hangs in soft ripples over her shoulders and never gets out of order. Her hazel eyes are gentle and mild.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025)_

## Personality

Dora is a very quiet, obedient, and well-behaved child who is naturally faithful and methodical in her small duties. She is timid and easily frightened, especially by morbid stories, yet remains calm and composed under pressure. Unlike her mischievous twin brother, she is so neat, proper, and orderly that Anne and Marilla sometimes find her behavior somewhat monotonous.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005), [v2 c10 P88](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0088), [v2 c10 P89](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0089), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c21 P4](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0004), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025)_

## Goals

- To be a good and helpful child at Green Gables  <sub>[v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012)</sub>

## History

Following the death of her mother in East Grafton, Dora and her twin brother Davy were taken in by Marilla Cuthbert and Anne Shirley at Green Gables for the winter, as their uncle Richard Keith could not immediately care for them. Unlike Davy, Dora adjusted smoothly to life at Green Gables, behaving politely and assisting with household errands. During the local Aid Society meeting, Davy tricked her into walking the pigpen fence, resulting in her falling in and getting thoroughly soaked when he attempted to pump her clean. When school opened, she was assigned to sit with Mirabel Cotton, who frightened her with stories of dead relatives and ghosts until Anne intervened. She began cultivating her own small garden plot in the spring, successfully growing vegetables through careful tending. In the autumn, word arrived that her uncle Richard had died, leaving a trust fund for the twins, ensuring that Dora would remain permanently at Green Gables.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c1 P32](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0032), [v2 c7 P25](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0025), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c8 P48](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0048), [v2 c8 P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c22 P23](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0023), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010)_

- Daughter of Mary Keith and third cousin of Marilla Cuthbert  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c1 P35](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0035)</sub>
